messages:
nate: FYI mkdocs linkcheck failing after the latest formatter patch. getting 404s for encoded anchors - e.g. /docs/intro/#overview%3A on staging
sophie: can you paste the exact error and the source link?
nate: log:
```
WARNING - 404: /docs/intro/#overview%3A
WARNING - The page 'guides/quickstart.md' contains a broken reference to 'intro/#overview%3A'
```
yves: looks like some headings include a trailing colon in the source ("Overview:") but our slugifier sometimes strips punctuation and sometimes doesn't, producing `overview` vs `overview%3A`. mismatch = broken jump.
sophie: short-term patch: normalize anchors at build time to a canonical form (strip trailing punctuation then percent-encode) and emit a small redirect map so both variants resolve.
yves: i'll open a tiny PR that implements canonicalize_anchor() and a redirect JSON emitted into /site/_anchors.json. also add unit tests for trailing-colon and percent-encoding edgecases.
ci-bot: linkcheck failed for branch fix/anchor-encoding. See https://ci.internal/anchors/7789
sophie: also add a tools/regen-links.py helper to rewrite existing intra-doc links to the canonical form; make it opt-in. that will let us gradually fix the repo without a big mass-PR.
yves: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/820 - includes canonicalizer + regen tool + small migration note. didn't touch translations.
docs-bot: PR merged by sophie. nightly build started.
ci-bot: nightly linkcheck completed: no remaining 404s; anchor-compat redirect plugin enabled. created ticket DOCS-590 to sweep repo and update legacy links.
nate: thanks all. leaving a quick contributor note in CONTRIBUTING.md: "If you edit a heading, run `tools/regen-links.py` to avoid stale anchors."
sophie: added small SDK snippet to guides showing `encodeURIComponent('Overview:')` example.
